replies.body: Well I made it using several AI's o3-mini, sonnet 3.5 and used some deep seek too when the other 2 were struggling to achieve what I was asking. Don't really know much coding myself so would never be able to make a game without ai, I know little bits so I was able to twerk certain parts but I'd say 98% was done by ai.
